name: Daviess County, Indiana (United States)
description: Steel blue field with a red and white striped triangle rising from the bottom to the top, the "Thoroughfare for Freedom", charged with the county seal in a white ring and a ring of thirteen white stars.
history: Daviess County is a county in southwestern Indiana. The flag, known as the "Thoroughfare for Freedom" flag, was created by Kathleen J. Cavanaugh for a county-wide contest held in 1975 and adopted on 1 January 1976 to coincide with the United States Bicentennial.

features.role: red and white striped triangle, the Thoroughfare for Freedom
